effects: Moves NFT tokenId from `from` to `to` and clears its single-token approval.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom interpolatedIntent leaves out `from`, though the transferFrom sentence includes it.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256) interpolatedIntent "Safely transfer token {tokenId} to {to}" vs transferFrom "Transfer token {tokenId} from {from} to {to}". The ERC721.safeTransferFrom code lets an approved operator move a token that `from` owns.

effects: Moves NFT tokenId from `from` to `to` and clears its single-token approval.
If `to` is a contract, calls its onERC721Received with `data` and reverts unless it accepts.
formats.shown: Safe transfer of the named artwork to the To address; From is a field, data is not shown.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom with data: interpolatedIntent leaves out `from`.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json interpolatedIntent "Safely transfer token {tokenId} to {to}"; the From field is shown separately.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom `data` bytes are not shown; they only go to the recipient's onERC721Received callback.
findings.evidence: ERC721._checkOnERC721Received(from,to,tokenId,data) in FeralfileExhibitionV3_3.sol; no `data` field in the descriptor.
findings.fix: None needed. Optionally show data as raw with visible optional.

effects: Sets `operator` as the single approved address for tokenId, so it can transfer that token (caller must be its owner or an operator for all of its tokens; the operator filter applies).

effects: Grants (approved=true) or revokes (approved=false) `operator`'s right to transfer every token the signer holds in this collection, now and later.
formats.shown: "true all tokens for <operator>" or "false all tokens for <operator>", with Approved shown as a raw boolean.

findings.title: setApprovalForAll puts the raw boolean into the sentence: "true all tokens for X".
findings.evidence: descriptor.json interpolatedIntent "{approved} all tokens for {operator}" and field approved format raw; case 4 shows "true all tokens for Test Operator" and Approved "true". The intent "Set operator approval" does not say whether this grants or revokes.
findings.fix: Use an enum or a boolean label map (true → "Grant", false → "Revoke"), and a sentence like "{approved} full control of all your artworks in this collection to {operator}".

effects: Permanently destroys each listed edition token the signer owns or is approved for, and deletes its edition record and IPFS CID registration (only if isBurnable).
formats.shown: Permanently destroy the listed artworks, each shown by name.

formats.key: authorizedTransfer((address from,address to,uint256 tokenID,uint256 expireTime,bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_)[] transferParams_)
effects: Only a trustee or the owner can call it. For each entry, moves tokenID from `from` to `to` using an off-chain signature from `from`, which must be unexpired; recipient contracts get an onERC721Received callback.
Moves none of the signer's own assets.
formats.shown: Execute authorized artwork transfers; for each entry From, To, Artwork and the expiry date appear as separate array fields.

findings.title: authorizedTransfer intent says "Authorize", but the signer runs transfers that others already signed.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json intent "Authorize artwork transfer"; code FeralfileExhibitionV3._authorizedTransfer checks the signature of transferParam_.from and then calls _safeTransfer. The signer grants nothing.
findings.fix: Use the intent "Execute signed artwork transfers".

findings.title: authorizedTransfer shows from/to/tokenID/expireTime as separate lists the signer must pair by hand.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json fields transferParams_.[].from, transferParams_.[].to, transferParams_.[].tokenID, transferParams_.[].expireTime as four separate fields.
findings.fix: Group the fields per transferParams_ element so each transfer reads as one row.

formats.key: createArtworks((string title,string artistName,string fingerprint,uint256 editionSize,uint256 AEAmount,uint256 PPAmount)[] artworks_)
effects: Only a trustee or the owner can call it. Registers each artwork with title, artist, fingerprint (which sets the artwork ID), editionSize, plus AE and PP amounts that raise the mintable supply to editionSize+AEAmount+PPAmount.
formats.shown: Create artworks, with Title, Artist and Edition size for each one.

findings.title: createArtworks hides AEAmount and PPAmount, so the mintable supply looks smaller than it is.
findings.evidence: FeralfileExhibitionV3._mintArtwork requires editionNumber_ < editionSize + AEAmount + PPAmount; the descriptor shows only artworks_.[].editionSize.
findings.fix: Add fields for artworks_.[].AEAmount ('Artist editions') and artworks_.[].PPAmount ('Printer proofs').

findings.title: createArtworks shows title, artist and edition size as separate lists with no grouping per artwork.
findings.fix: Group the fields per artworks_ element.

formats.key: batchMint((uint256 artworkID,uint256 edition,address artist,address owner,string ipfsCID)[] mintParams_)
effects: On 0x2a86…: only a trustee or the owner can call it. For each entry, mints token artworkID+edition to `artist`, transfers it to `owner` if they differ, and records ipfsCID as the token metadata.
formats.shown: Batch mint editions, with Artwork ID, Edition and Owner per entry.

findings.title: batchMint hides the artist (the first holder of each mint) and the ipfsCID that becomes token metadata.
findings.evidence: FeralfileExhibitionV3._mintArtwork: `_safeMint(artist_, editionID); if (artist_ != owner_) _safeTransfer(artist_, owner_, …)` and `artworkEditions[editionID] = ArtworkEdition(editionID, ipfsCID_)`. The descriptor has no field for mintParams_.[].artist or mintParams_.[].ipfsCID.
findings.fix: Add fields for mintParams_.[].artist ('Artist') and mintParams_.[].ipfsCID ('Metadata CID').

findings.title: batchMint shows artwork ID, edition and owner as separate lists the signer must pair.
findings.fix: Group the fields per mintParams_ element.

findings.title: batchMint always reverts on deployment 0x559f…, but the screen still says it mints editions.
findings.fix: None needed. The descriptor cannot vary by deployment; the transaction moves nothing.
